name: Ostentation
overview: Scripture warns against ostentation, especially in acts of prayer and almsgiving, emphasizing the importance of sincerity before God rather than seeking human praise. Proverbs highlights the folly of boasting in false gifts and urges believers to let others commend them rather than self-praise. Jesus teaches that giving to be seen by others forfeits the reward from the Father in heaven, underscoring that true righteousness is a matter of the heart and unseen devotion.
